hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom AMM hook that implements a bonding curve backed by Euler vaults. It handles swaps entirely in beforeSwap by taking input tokens from the PoolManager, depositing them into Euler vault positions, and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass Uniswap's native AMM pricing.
